newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on Japan, evening before report.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on Japan, evening before report.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on Japan export demand and position evening ahead of Thursday's Statistics Canada output report, traders said.

"There was Japanese buying in the January all day, crushers bought 200 May in the last hour and everyone's covering shorts ahead of tomorrow's report," a trader said. Japanese export demand was much lower in November compared to October. Japanese exporters bought 500 Jan-Mar spread at $1.50, LFG bought Jan-May $2. January futures crush margin fell to -46.05 from -41.74 Tuesday on January soyoil, meal.
Japan bought 8,000-10,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola rose $3.40 to $406.20, May rose $2.90 to $404.60. Volume was heavy 5,268 lots with 160 hedges.
January flax lost $1 to $359, September rose $1.40 to $351.90 ahead of StatsCan's report. July-Sept spread at $12.
"September flax is weighing on the whole complex to keep spreads in line," a trader said. Volume was 410 lots.
December feed wheat rose $0.90 to $167, March rose $1.30 to $169 on commission short covering. Mar-May $0.50.
February western barley rose $1.10 to $139.60 on short covering ahead of StatsCan, March rose $1.10 to $139, 350 Feb-May spread at even money then 250 at $0.50. Volume 2,000.
James Richardson & Sons sold 25 December oats to Louis Dreyfus unchanged at US$119. LFG sold five May peas unchanged to PCTS at US$198, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
